objective: Calibrate correlated waveform-model discrepancy and propagate it through gravitational-wave parameter estimation, with posterior coverage and false-GR-deviation control as primary outcomes.
scientific_question: Does a joint parameter-dependent waveform-discrepancy model improve posterior reliability over point-estimate, GP amplitude/phase, parameterized-error, model-accuracy mixture, and independent-model ensemble baselines at matched computational cost?

primary_references.title: Incorporation of model accuracy in gravitational wave Bayesian inference
primary_references.relevance: Model-accuracy-informed Bayesian combination; reports 30% lower computational resources and more faithful parameter recovery in its simulated comparison.

primary_references.title: Incorporating waveform calibration error in gravitational-wave modeling and inference for SEOBNRv4
primary_references.relevance: Gaussian-process modeling and marginalization of frequency-domain amplitude and phase deviations.

primary_references.title: Accounting for the known unknowns: A parametric framework to incorporate systematic waveform errors in gravitational-wave parameter estimation
primary_references.relevance: Parameterized amplitude/phase waveform-error priors and injection-recovery.

primary_references.title: Impact of numerical-relativity waveform calibration on parametrized post-Einsteinian tests
primary_references.relevance: Reports false pPE deviations at network SNR 60 in the baseline analysis and a consistent-with-zero deformation through SNR 330 with uncertainty-aware calibration in the studied setup.

primary_references.title: Uncertainty-Aware Waveform Modeling for High-SNR Gravitational-Wave Inference
primary_references.relevance: Propagation of NR surrogate and calibration-coefficient uncertainty into waveform inference.

discrepancy_model.discrepancy: delta_h is a complex, parameter-dependent residual process over frequency, mode, and source parameters.
required_outputs: conditional discrepancy mean / bias correction where supported
posterior predictive samples or a documented likelihood-marginalization approximation
calibrated applicability domain and abstention state
candidate_parameterizations: correlated log-amplitude and phase residual processes
low-rank latent frequency/mode basis with parameter-dependent coefficients
discrepancy_model.prohibition: Do not add an uncalibrated scalar or diagonal variance term to the detector PSD. Detector noise, detector calibration, NR numerical error, surrogate error, and physical model discrepancy must retain separate provenance and correlation semantics.

uncertainty_sources.meaning: Observed detector noise described by a pinned PSD / likelihood and data-quality context.
Frequency-dependent amplitude/phase calibration uncertainty in the detector response.
Finite resolution, truncation, outer boundary, extraction radius, extrapolation, and CCE-vs-extrapolated differences.
Residual error on held-out complete NR configurations within the declared interpolation domain.
Structured difference among EOB, phenomenological, BOB, NR-surrogate, perturbative, and other waveform families.
Missing higher modes, mode mixing, precession/eccentricity mismatch, QNM basis and start-time choices.
Finite precision, interpolation, quadrature, FFT, and numerical evaluation error.

reference_models.purpose: Baseline showing the cost of ignoring waveform error.
Reproduce published GP calibration baseline on a matched domain.
Reproduce accuracy-aware model combination on a matched test.
Use explicit evidence/accuracy weights and account for correlated training provenance.
Joint frequency/mode/parameter-conditioned discrepancy with posterior marginalization and OOD abstention.

data_split_policy.grouping_unit: complete NR simulation ID / physical configuration
rules: Never split neighboring time samples or waveform modes from one simulation across train and test.
Keep resolution variants and extrapolation orders for the same physical configuration in one split group, except when testing resolution convergence explicitly.
Keep CCE and extrapolated products linked by their common physical source group.
Reserve complete source configurations and parameter-space boundary regions for untouched final evaluation.
Publish exact train/validation/test simulation IDs and source file digests.
Do not use the final test set for hyperparameter tuning, calibration, model selection, or active NR acquisition.

adversarial_injections: coherent phase bias concentrated in a narrow frequency band
correlated surrogate families with overlapping training simulations
injection_campaign.general_relativity_false_discovery: Inject GR-consistent signals and measure false positive rates for parametrized post-Einsteinian deviations before and after discrepancy marginalization.
injection_campaign.real_deviation_sensitivity: Inject declared non-GR or phenomenological deviations to test that conservative discrepancy modeling does not erase identifiable departures.

required_metrics: nominal 50%, 90%, and 95% credible interval coverage with binomial confidence intervals
posterior bias for component masses, remnant mass/spin, inclination, distance, and other declared parameters
negative log predictive density or another preregistered proper scoring rule
posterior predictive residual checks and residual whiteness
false-positive rate for parametrized-GR deviations under GR-consistent injections
OOD detection recall, OOD false acceptance, and in-domain false abstention
wall time, peak memory, and time-to-posterior-accuracy at matched coverage

proposed_targets_not_claims.false_gr_deviation_rate: No worse than the calibrated reference baseline at matched sensitivity; report confidence intervals.
proposed_targets_not_claims.posterior_accuracy: Improve proper scoring / time-to-posterior-accuracy over point-estimate and naïve mixture baselines at matched coverage.

active_nr_selection.acquisition_objective: expected reduction in posterior uncertainty and discrepancy-calibration error
candidate_scores: cross-model disagreement after accounting for shared training data
coverage gaps by mode, SNR, eccentricity, precession, and mass ratio
active_nr_selection.comparison: Compare posterior calibration and uncertainty reduction at equal expensive NR simulation budgets, including acquisition compute cost.
active_nr_selection.leakage_rule: The final untouched simulation set must not influence acquisition or tuning.

evidence_requirements: exact waveform files and cryptographic digests
frequency grid, PSD, alignment, windowing and frequency band
posterior samples and random seeds where relevant
calibration curves, proper scores, coverage confidence intervals and null-control outcomes

no_claims: No discrepancy model has been trained or calibrated by this manifest.
No posterior inference or injection-recovery experiment has been executed by this manifest.
Published reference results are not Symtropy/Symthaea results.
